The PRD requires 'auto-submits auto-best if no choice made before countdown ends' — currently the timer just stops at 0s with no API call.

rca of the issue: PlayerVerifyPanel.tsx: developer added JSX onClick={handleSyncDraftClass} + the syncYear/syncing state hooks (lines 62-63) but forgot to author the handler function body. Because the file is marked @ts-nocheck, TypeScript would have flagged this but is silenced. ESLint also passes (handleSyncDraftClass is treated as an unresolved JSX reference, not an undefined variable). Repro: log in as admin → /admin → click Player Verify tab → page shows 'Uncaught runtime errors: handleSyncDraftClass is not defined' overlay. Mitigation: define handleSyncDraftClass = async () => { setSyncing(true); try { const { data } = await api.post('/admin/players/sync-draft-class', { year: syncYear }); toast.success(`Synced ${data.added} new + ${data.updated} updated for ${syncYear}`); await fetchPlayers(); } catch (e) { toast.error(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Sync failed'); } finally { setSyncing(false); } }; — wire a confirm() dialog before the POST per the PRD.
